Privacy

You do not create a user profile within the portal. This private test is accessed through its hosting platform. Saved cards remain in your browser. Our application code processes chosen photographs and recognized text on your device, without uploading the photograph or OCR text to a server.

Operator and legal basis

The legal operator, correspondence address and privacy contact are not yet configured. They must be published before public launch. Requested local saving and scanning are intended to deliver the functionality you ask for; where personal data are involved, the intended basis is performance of the usage agreement (GDPR Article 6(1)(b)). Necessary delivery and security are intended to rely on legitimate interests (Article 6(1)(f)), subject to the operator documenting necessity and balancing before public launch. Camera permission is a device permission, not blanket consent to other processing.

Data and retention

  • Saved cards: card identifiers, names, language, set and image URL in your browser’s localStorage. They remain until you delete them or your browser clears site data. There is no automatic expiry, central collection database or account synchronization.
  • Photos and recognized text: temporary page memory for recognition and matching. Clear the scan, close the scanner after recognition, choose another photo or close the page to release it. Deleting a scan does not delete the original photo in your photo library.
  • Searches and filters: processed in page memory. Opening a marketplace link can include a card search term in that website’s URL.
  • Technical requests: hosts and external providers can receive IP addresses, requested URLs, timestamps and browser/connection information. Their actual log periods have not yet been verified; we do not claim a verified fixed retention period.
  • Exports: backup files you download or import are handled locally. You are responsible for deleting separate backups.

External providers

The current private site is delivered through ChatGPT Sites (OpenAI), using Cloudflare infrastructure. Platform authentication and security may involve their own cookies and processing. See the OpenAI Privacy Policy and Cloudflare Privacy Policy.

TCGdex serves card images and set logos at assets.tcgdex.net and card details or non-English catalogs at api.tcgdex.net. A requested card ID or image URL can reveal which card is being requested. The English base index is served by our own host.

After you choose a photo, the browser downloads Tesseract.js, worker and core files from cdn.jsdelivr.net, and language files from tessdata.projectnaptha.com. Those servers receive file download requests, not your photo or OCR text. The current configuration disables Tesseract’s persistent language cache. The browser may still cache ordinary program and image files. A language model is chosen using the card language, independently of the interface language.

Marketplace links open Cardmarket, TCGplayer, eBay or Pokemonkaart.nl only when you click them. No marketplace widgets are embedded. Their policies apply after navigation. The application has no advertising, analytics, tracking pixels or Google Fonts. Its fetch requests omit cookies and referrer information; pages also request a no-referrer policy.

Sponsoring

The voluntary support link opens GitHub Sponsors. GitHub and its payment providers handle any account and payment information under their own terms. This portal does not process payment card information or embed a payment widget. The project operator may receive sponsor information depending on your settings and GitHub’s functionality; that processing and retention must be documented when Sponsors is activated. Sponsoring does not unlock exclusive catalog features.

Transfers, security and your rights

Provider infrastructure may operate outside the EEA. Processing locations, provider roles, contracts and transfer safeguards still need confirmation. We do not promise that all processing stays in the EU. The site uses HTTPS and local scan processing. Photograph only cards, without faces, addresses or other personal information.

Where applicable you have rights of access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability and objection to legitimate-interest processing. You may withdraw consent where a processing activity relies on it, without affecting earlier lawful processing. Requests should be made to the operator contact once configured; the usual response period is one month, subject to permitted extensions. You may complain to the Dutch Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens or your competent supervisory authority. Host account or third-party provider data may require contacting those providers.

To export or delete browser data, open Saved → Export saved cards / Delete saved cards. This does not remove separate photo files, downloads, platform cookies or data on another device. An interface choice is kept in the page URL, not in a separate tracking identifier.

The iPhone development version

The native app uses its bundled English index, Apple Vision and local UserDefaults. It does not require Tesseract downloads. Its local collection is separate from the browser collection; deleting one does not delete the other. Card images and details still load through TCGdex. App Store privacy information and a publicly accessible final privacy URL must be completed before distribution.

Children and automated suggestions

Ask a parent or guardian for help if you are unsure about a photo or an external website. The application does not profile users or make decisions with legal or similarly significant effects. Recognition results are suggestions, not proof of authenticity, condition or value.

Cookies & local storage

The portal code sets no HTTP cookies. It stores your chosen collection in kaartkompas-saved-v2 when you use saving or import. The deletion function also removes the older kaartkompas-saved key. This functional storage has no automatic expiry and is not a cross-site identifier. Equivalent storage technologies can be subject to cookie rules.

No separate “accept all” banner has been added for this requested functional storage. This does not mean every host cookie or external request is automatically exempt. Platform cookies and their names/durations still require verification before public launch. Any future non-essential tracking must stay disabled until valid consent, with equally accessible refusal and withdrawal.

Photos, canvas data and object URLs are temporary. Ordinary browser caches or older OCR caches can be cleared through the browser’s site-data settings. Deleting saved cards does not clear those caches, host sessions or downloaded backups.

Terms of use

Bindtopia is an independent card discovery, recognition and collection project. This version is a free private test. We do not sell cards, broker transactions or act as a party to purchases on external websites. Voluntary sponsoring through GitHub does not promise ownership of artwork, investment returns, guaranteed features or development delivery.

Coverage depends on the source database and card language. Details and images may be incomplete, out of date or incorrect. Always verify the card name, set, number, language and print variant. A scan is not authentication, grading, a condition assessment or a valuation.

Price links open third-party search results. Check that any result matches your exact edition, language and condition, and check currency, delivery charges and seller terms. We provide no investment advice or future value guarantee.

Saved collections are local, without automatic cloud backup or synchronization. Export a backup before clearing browser data. Availability and continued access to external sources are not guaranteed. The service may change or be temporarily unavailable.

Use the scanner for card photographs. Do not upload or select unnecessary personal or sensitive content, damage the service or bypass access restrictions. Viewing content does not authorize commercial redistribution, counterfeiting or infringement of third-party rights.

The MIT software license covers original project code and documentation, not Pokémon trademarks, card designs or illustrations. The source-database license applies only to rights its provider can grant. No general license for the project’s use of Pokémon images has been established. Attribution, public availability and open-source publication are not substitutes for permission or an applicable legal exception.

We exercise reasonable care while providing this test service with its stated limitations. To the extent permitted by applicable law, we are not liable for damage arising solely from incorrect third-party information, mistaken recognition, external outages or loss of exclusively local data. This does not exclude liability that cannot lawfully be excluded or restrict mandatory consumer rights.

Contact details for errors, security concerns and rights notices are still to be supplied. Appropriate notices may result in review or temporary removal. Future material changes will be made apparent. Dutch law is intended to apply without removing mandatory protection or court rights available to consumers in their country. The project does not promise compliance with every jurisdiction merely by providing translated interfaces.

Rights & contact

Legal operator, correspondence address, company details where applicable, and support/privacy/rights email: not yet supplied. These are not automatically copied from a personal ChatGPT or GitHub account.

Card data come from TCGdex; see the included database license. Card images and Pokémon marks remain with their respective rights holders. Bindtopia is not affiliated with or endorsed by The Pokémon Company, Nintendo, Creatures or GAME FREAK. Tesseract.js uses Apache-2.0; Apple SDK terms apply to the native app. The project does not include a copied Pokemonkaart.nl database or its editorial text.

When the rights contact is configured, notices should identify the exact page/card ID, the protected work and right, your authority to act, the alleged infringement and a reply address. Do not send unnecessary identity documents. Notices will require assessment; they are not automatically accepted or rejected.

The English information accompanies the Dutch draft, and does not override mandatory local rights. Hosting arrangements and contact details must be finalized before a public launch.
